about: Gravita India Limited manufactures and recycles lead metal, lead products, aluminium alloys, and plastic granules in India, the United Arab Emirates, South Korea, and internationally. It operates through Lead Processing, Aluminium Processing, Turn-Key Solutions, and Plastic Manufacturing segments.
